title: 苹果发布会转向创作者：网红酒店商务舱有人买单，两天洛杉矶活动图什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And this is going to be a creator focused event. Now, I think it was our first episode where I talked about influencers and how there's lots of influencers with these Apple events and Apple
segments.zh: 这将是一场以创作者为中心的活动。我记得在第一期节目里，我谈到过网红，以及苹果活动上有很多网红，苹果

segments.en: shifting their PR and marketing towards them. Well, I said that it's very likely these people are either getting paid or getting their trips covered. I can tell you exclusively on the power
segments.zh: 将公关和营销转向他们。我说过，这些人很可能要么获得报酬，要么差旅费被承担。我可以在Power On播客上独家告诉你

segments.en: on podcasts that I have confirmation now that Apple does indeed offer influencers paid hotel,
segments.zh: 我现在确认，苹果确实为网红提供付费酒店，

segments.en: paid business class travel to go to these launch events. And they are planning a two-day spectacle for certain influencers in LA that includes meetings with John Ternis, the new CEO
segments.zh: 付费商务舱旅行，前往这些发布活动。他们计划在洛杉矶为某些网红举办为期两天的活动，包括与新CEO约翰·特尼斯会面

segments.en: and other Apple executives includes a dinner on the evening of the 27th.
segments.zh: 以及其他苹果高管，还包括27日晚上的晚宴。

segments.en: So you can already tell how they're trying to position this. They want influencers, they want creative types, they want video editors, music specialists, etc. to be playing up these
segments.zh: 所以你已经能看出他们如何定位。他们想要网红，想要创意人士，想要视频编辑、音乐专家等来宣传这些

segments.en: new iPads and these new Macs, which of course is unsurprising because this is how they've tried to position the Mac now for several years.
segments.zh: 新iPad和新Mac，这当然不足为奇，因为这就是他们多年来试图定位Mac的方式。
